description: Backup option of a server and its backups (id, SCHEDULED / MANUAL, CREATING / AVAILABLE / FAILED, date, size in GB). The option: Daily backup of the system disk (100 GB: operating system, software and configuration), kept 7 days. The work disk (high-capacity local storage) is not included: back up your important data elsewhere. The server is briefly interrupted during the backup, at the time you choose. Option state: enabled, supported, hourLocal (0-23, Eastern time), retention, price per month and billing (hourly: pro rata per billed hour; prepaid: per period). (permission: servers:read) [Requires a free GPU Cloud account and MCP key]
name: gpucloud_list_server_backups
title: Server backups
